description: Source code implementing the fsmonitor IPC API with support for platform-specific behavior, including functions for checking support, getting the IPC path, getting the IPC state, and sending queries and commands to the fsmonitor daemon.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__is_supported
methods.description: Checks if the fsmonitor IPC is supported on the current platform.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_path
methods.description: Returns the IPC path for the given repository.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current IPC active state.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_query
methods.description: Sends a query to the fsmonitor daemon with an optional since token, retrieves the response.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_command
methods.description: Sends a command to the fsmonitor daemon and retrieves the response.
